items.t: Is D Wave Quantum (QBTS) Priced Too Richly For Its Book Value?
items.sum: D-Wave Quantum has been through a wild stretch in the market, and with quantum computing headlines swinging between strong bookings and legal setbacks, investors are increasingly asking whether the current share price lines up with what the company’s balance sheet actually supports through its book value. items.t: QBTS Q3 Earnings Call Highlights System Sales and Quantum Roadmap
items.sum: QBTS highlights a surging system-sales pipeline, a planned fourth-quarter delivery and technical milestones across its annealing and gate-model platforms.

items.t: D Wave Quantum (QBTS) Stock Price Sinks As Q3 Results Expose Cash Burn
items.sum: D-Wave Quantum came into this Q3 2026 report as a high-concept quantum computing story stock that had already dropped 49% over the past three months. The reaction today was immediate, and the share price fell 8.8% to US$10.46 by the close. The headline number was not revenue. It was cash burn and losses. items.t: QBTS Stock Down on Q3 Earnings Miss, Revenues Surpass Estimates
items.sum: D-Wave's Q3 revenues increase 21% and nine-month bookings surge 611%, while margin pressure and a widening adjusted EBITDA loss cloud its Q3 results.

items.t: D-Wave Quantum (QBTS) Lands $100 Million CHIPS Act Deal As Bookings Jump
items.sum: D-Wave Quantum (NasdaqGS: QBTS) secured a definitive agreement for up to US$100 million in U.S. CHIPS Act funding. The business reported a 21% YoY revenue increase and a sharp rise in bookings in its latest update.
